voiceover: The 1998 tape has a flat screen in it.
Back corner of the room. Behind the cake.
Flat. Thin. Wrong by about fifteen years.
Nobody at the party is looking at it.
He digitises it and zooms in.
The screen is lit. There is an image on it.
Beige walls. An anglepoise lamp. An open laptop.
He sits back from the screen.
[BEAT] He is sitting in that room right now.
Same angle. Same lamp. Same laptop.
He turns around. Nothing behind him.
The tape is twenty-eight years old.
And one by one, everyone at the party turns.
His mother. His uncle. A child he does not know.
All of them looking at the screen.
All of them looking at him.

hooks.text: The listing is a photo of her living room.
hooks.note: Nine words, immediately visual, and the violation is obvious without explanation.

hooks.text: Someone is selling her lamp. It is still on her table.
hooks.note: Excellent contradiction, slightly longer, and names the object before the intrusion.

hooks.text: The marketplace photo was taken inside her house.
hooks.note: Strong, but 'was taken inside' is a small extra step of reasoning.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 is the only one where the viewer's own recognition does the work. A shopping listing showing someone's private living room is understood instantly and in any market, and the intrusion lands before a single fact has been explained.
voiceover: The listing is a photo of her living room.
Her lamp. Her table. Her window behind it.
Posted two weeks ago. The seller has no name.
The lamp is still on the table.
She checks the angle. It is from the doorway.
Nobody has been in that room but her.
So she buys it.
[BEAT] The parcel arrives on Thursday.
It is her lamp. The chip on the base. The taped cable.
She turns to the table.
The lamp there is perfect. New. Unmarked.
So she searches the rest of the house.
Every object she owns is in somebody's purchase history.
Bought years ago. Delivered years ago.
None of the buyers are her.

hooks.text: Thirty-one people walked in. Nobody walked out.
hooks.note: Eight words and a complete mystery. The strongest raw hook line in the batch.

hooks.text: A year of doorbell footage and not one departure.
hooks.note: Same idea, stated analytically rather than as an image.

hooks.text: The camera records arrivals. It has never recorded a leaving.
hooks.note: Good rhythm, but a beat slower to comprehend.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 is a complete story in eight words: a number, an action, and an impossible absence. It needs no device knowledge, no setup, and no second sentence to become unsettling.
voiceover: Thirty-one people walked in. Nobody walked out.
A year of doorbell footage. She checks all of it.
Deliveries. A plumber. Her sister, twice.
Every one of them walks up and goes inside.
The porch is always empty again afterwards.
No exits. Not one. Not in a single year.
So she slows the footage down.
The plumber's hands are her hands.
[BEAT] Every visitor has the same gait.
Thirty-one arrivals. All of them her.
Different coats. Different hours. Same shoulders.
She checks tonight's clip.
She arrives at six, like always.
The front door has been locked since Tuesday.
She has not left the house today.
And the camera is already recording the next one.
